name: red-new-session-all-sessions
note: G1 design §9, item 1: spawn-count == session-count, and EVERY session's geometry checked. Four IST sessions of three bars each; one spawn per session; each object closes on its own session's last bar (2, 5, 8) and the final session's object rides the live edge open at lastBarIndex=11. This is the first conversion's bug 2: a session reset keyed off a condition true for every intraday bar spawned only ONCE across eight sessions, and the check that missed it inspected only the newest spawn -- which was the only spawn that existed. A four-item expectation cannot be satisfied by one object. The live-edge property of G1 §4 is folded in here as the last item rather than given its own fixture.
